item.title: The First Goodbye: One Mom’s Guide to College Drop-Off
item.description: I recently saw a post on Instagram that said, “I was so wrapped in the responsibilities of motherhood, that I almost forgot this was my first time experiencing motherhood in my 40s too. ” Often our children's firsts are ours as well. (Photo Credit: Jessica Marie) It was basically reminding us that our life and experiences in motherhood are firsts for us and just as important as all of our children’s childhood experiences and firsts too.

item.title: When My Sons Left and I Didn’t Cry: A Therapist on Letting Go of Adult Children
item.description: After an extended winter break, I said goodbye to my three college-aged sons. I hugged each of them tightly, told them I loved them, and added my usual reminder to “make good decisions. ” As a therapist I know that our sons' pulling away is healthy but as a mom, it hurt.

item.title: Advice On Selecting a College From College President (And Dad)
item.description: The college admission process can be daunting. item.title: How to Talk With Your Teen About Choosing Their Major in College
item.description: A few years ago at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, one of the school’s deans greeted a group of incoming freshmen with this question: “How many of you know exactly what you want to major in here at Madison? ” Hundreds of arms shot confidently into the air. Many teens feel pressure to choose their major before they begin college.

item.title: My Son’s Rejection from College Is Difficult for Me
item.description: My son is smart, authentic and unusual, but his deepest feelings have been a mystery to me since he became a teen. This makes his senior year and the college search and application process difficult for me. How was my highly-qualified son rejected from his Early Decision college?

item.title: Nine Reasons Why Some Teens Behave Badly Before They Leave Home
item.description: Sometimes teens will lash out or misbehave during the spring semester of their high school senior year. But why is this? This should be one of the most exciting times in your child’s life.
